title: Behavior delta between two compatibility profiles
description: The difference between two PowerShell versions expressed as data, so the site can answer 'what would this script do differently on 7.7?' without anyone re-reading a changelog. Generated by diffing two profiles, then annotated by hand with migration guidance.

subject.description: What changed: a command name, a behavior key, an automatic variable, or an engine area.

migration.description: What a script author should do. Required for impact=script-breaking.

conformanceFixture.description: Path to the fixture proving BrowserShell reproduces this difference. A script-breaking change without a fixture is unproven.

implemented.description: Whether BrowserShell actually models this yet. False means documented but not emulated; the UI must say so rather than imply fidelity.
